value.type67_rule: mode 0 includes fully contained type-67 byte spans and sets MSB0 bit control_enable_bit_1based-1; L is the highest selected mask-byte index plus one. P5 mode 5 uses the first row with start_byte <= data_byte_offset < start_byte+width, data_byte_offset+data_byte_length <= start_byte+width and exact +0x0C/+0x0E bit bounds. A matched zero enable key returns C0040102; no matching mode-5 row yields L=0.

value.adapter: DiagAdaptation logical-value conversion writes these fields directly; SetValue is a separate native-caller path
value.engine_selection: ordinary category generation low5bits 0x14/0x15 selects P5 and 0x16 selects P6; controller mode, multi-ECU flags and populated connection state can instead select Dual/Fuel. The category alone does not establish the loaded executor.
value.source_scope: current main GTSPlus DataMonitorPhase5_DT.dll and DataMonitorPhase6_DT.dll
